svg.title: ACP checkout session status (2026-04-17, 11 values)
svg.desc: State diagram: ACP checkout session status (2026-04-17, 11 values). 11 states: incomplete, not_ready_for_payment, requires_escalation, authentication_required, ready_for_payment, pending_approval, in_progress, complete_in_progress, completed, canceled, and expired. Starts in not_ready_for_payment. Ends in completed, canceled, and expired. 16 transitions. From not_ready_for_payment to ready_for_payment when Buyer data and fulfillment choice complete (POST /checkout_sessions/ id ). From incomplete to not_ready_for_payment when Required data added (inferred from name) (POST /checkout_sessions/ id ). From ready_for_payment to not_ready_for_payment when Update invalidates the cart, for example out of stock (POST /checkout_sessions/ id ). From ready_for_payment to authentication_required when Merchant requires 3DS (session response). From authentication_required to completed when Complete with authentication_result (POST /checkout_sessions/ id /complete). From ready_for_payment to requires_escalation when Merchant needs buyer action outside the agent (inferred from name) (session response). From ready_for_payment to pending_approval when Approval required, for example B2B (inferred from name) (POST /checkout_sessions/ id /complete). From ready_for_payment to complete_in_progress when Complete accepted, payment still processing (inferred from name) (POST /checkout_sessions/ id /complete). From complete_in_progress to completed when Payment confirmed, order created (inferred) (GET /checkout_sessions/ id ). From ready_for_payment to in_progress when Processing (meaning not detailed) (POST /checkout_sessions/ id /complete). From in_progress to completed when Order created (POST /checkout_sessions/ id /complete). From ready_for_payment to completed when Complete succeeds response carries an order (POST /checkout_sessions/ id /complete). From not_ready_for_payment to canceled when Agent cancels, optional intent_trace (POST /checkout_sessions/ id /cancel). From ready_for_payment to canceled when Agent cancels, optional intent_trace (POST /checkout_sessions/ id /cancel). From ready_for_payment to expired when expires_at passes (inferred from name) (none). From not_ready_for_payment to expired when expires_at passes (inferred from name) (none).
